posts.title: My Jailbroken Kindle
posts.description: I jailbroke my Kindle inspired by Damnit Jeff’s video using Winterbreak (at the time the latest jailbreak). It wasn’t very difficult. If you have an old kindle lying around like I did (mine was like ten years old), then I implore you to jailbreak yours as well. posts.title: AI Slop Has Crept Into Our Movies
posts.description: Since I’ve made my computer into a dumb computer, I no longer watch YouTube constantly. Instead, I enjoy an occassional movie or TV show in the background. I like light hearted, oddball comedies. I enjoy watching completely random movies I’ve never heard of. I discover odd and fun movies like Drugstore June.

posts.title: What I Was Missing About Making Games
posts.description: This past weekend, I decided to make a card game. I’ve always been fascinated by the minimalism of a deck of cards, yet the infinite possibilities it holds for experiences. What I mean is a standard deck of cards is a very small object. It can fit in your pocket. There are only 52 cards with two jokers sometimes included.
